profile_id.description: HealthPilot profile id this interaction belongs to — one audit file per profile.

ai_used.description: Whether HealthPilot's AI path answered, or the deterministic no-AI fallback did.

tool_names.description: Names only of tools called for this interaction (e.g. ['get_today_nutrition']) — never their results, which can carry real health values.

memory_root.description: Directory this skill is permitted to append conversations/*.md under — nothing outside that pattern (see manifest memory.append_only).
